subcommands.name: create-cluster
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon DocumentDB elastic cluster and returns its cluster structure

options.name: --admin-user-name
options.description: The name of the Amazon DocumentDB elastic clusters administrator.  Constraints:   Must be from 1 to 63 letters or numbers.

options.name: --admin-user-password
options.description: The password for the Amazon DocumentDB elastic clusters administrator. The password can contain any printable ASCII characters.

options.name: --auth-type
options.description: The authentication type used to determine where to fetch the password used for accessing the elastic cluster. Valid types are PLAIN_TEXT or SECRET_ARN

options.name: --backup-retention-period
options.description: The number of days for which automatic snapshots are retained

options.name: --client-token
options.description: The client token for the elastic cluster

options.name: --cluster-name
options.description: The name of the new elastic cluster. This parameter is stored as a lowercase string.  Constraints:   Must contain from 1 to 63 letters, numbers, or hyphens.

options.name: --kms-key-id
options.description: The KMS key identifier to use to encrypt the new elastic cluster. The KMS key identifier is the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the KMS encryption key.

options.name: --preferred-backup-window
options.description: The daily time range during which automated backups are created if automated backups are enabled, as determined by the backupRetentionPeriod

options.name: --preferred-maintenance-window
options.description: The weekly time range during which system maintenance can occur, in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

options.name: --shard-capacity
options.description: The number of vCPUs assigned to each elastic cluster shard. Maximum is 64. Allowed values are 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64

options.name: --shard-count
options.description: The number of shards assigned to the elastic cluster. Maximum is 32

options.name: --shard-instance-count
options.description: The number of replica instances applying to all shards in the elastic cluster.

options.name: --subnet-ids
options.description: The Amazon EC2 subnet IDs for the new elastic cluster

options.name: --tags
options.description: The tags to be assigned to the new elastic cluster

options.name: --vpc-security-group-ids
